name: Formation of Mahila Mangal and Yuvak Mangal Dal
benefit: It is mandatory to form a group in order to avail the benefits of various schemes of the Youth Welfare and PRD Department and to collectively undertake any business activity.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be an interested woman or man. 1. The applicant must be a resident of a Gram Panchayat in Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be above 18 years of age.
